title: Document requirements for advertiser verification - Sudan - Advertising Policies Help

facts.fact: Organizations may be required to provide two types of documentation for advertiser verification in Sudan: organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative.
facts.quote: Organizations may be required to provide 2 different types of documentation for advertiser verification: organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative.

facts.fact: An authorized representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads, and their government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.
facts.quote: An authorized representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads. The government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.

facts.fact: Individuals in Sudan must submit a government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program, with passport, identification card, and driving license listed as acceptable documents.
facts.quote: Individuals must submit a government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program. Acceptable documents include: Passport, Identification card, Driving license

facts.fact: Individuals may also be required to submit a second proof-of-address document, such as a utility, phone, or internet bill, or a bank statement, dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A utility (for example, electricity, gas, water bill) or phone or internet bill (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: Bank statements used as proof of address must be dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A bank statement (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: Submitted government-issued photo IDs must be valid (not expired) and in color rather than black and white.
facts.quote: The ID is valid (not expired). The image is in color, not black and white.

facts.fact: Photocopies, screenshots, or photos taken through third-party apps may not be accepted as photo ID, and the front and back of the ID should be submitted separately when requested.
facts.quote: Photocopies, screenshots, or photos taken through third-party apps may not be accepted; we recommend using your device's native camera app.

facts.fact: Documents must be submitted only through the Ads UI and not by email, and agencies or third parties should not upload documents for multiple advertisers in the same file.
facts.quote: Only submit the requested documents through the Ads UI, don't send them over email.

facts.fact: Submitted document details must exactly match the payments profile info, including the organization name if applicable.
facts.quote: Make sure that the details in the submitted documents exactly match your payments profile info, including the organization name, if applicable.

facts.fact: Google states that personal data and verification documents won't be shared with any third party.
facts.quote: Personal data and documents won't be shared with any third party, as per the Google data protection policy.
